findings.path: Creation stock -> base monument construction -> separate paid upgrade -> derived physical effect

source_observed.observed_rule: The selected recipe switch charges no creation material for Stone. Soil consumes Stone; one Mountain uses 200,000 Stone before other count/mode modifiers. Unlocks and elapsed work still matter.

source_observed.symbol: BPMABPHBKOP selected production commit and APPFBNDJPEH
source_observed.observed_rule: An enabled, non-paused selected creation checks recipe availability and work threshold, then debits recipe stock and credits actual output stock. A shortage may activate a missing prerequisite and disable the requested output. Special bulk branches are qualified separately.
The actual monument renderer requires monument access. It exposes separate base and upgrade clone controls; upgrade controls use AOG access eligibility and the common allocation owner.

Base Mighty Statue construction begins at 2,000 Stone. Positive ordinary monument count scales this by 5 times count; EMC adds its explicit 10,000,000 multiplier. The actual constructor calls LOFCKMMDFLM and creates the attached AOG upgrade record.

The tick first advances the attached upgrade and applies its returned completion count. Base construction separately checks stock, optional paid divinity fallback and payment flag, pays material, then advances assigned worker time. The inspected completion branches increment the real monument and lifetime counts.

The attached record explicitly names itself Upgrade. Access requires LJDBHOBANHM. Its first Mighty Statue upgrade costs ten Mountains; positive individual upgrade count uses count squared, with separate bulk/EMC exceptions. Shortage returns before ordinary payment and may release clones or keep a warning. Sufficient work returns a completion count and clears payment/progress.

Completion increases the attached upgrade count and lifetime upgrade counter. Physical multiplier change is the upgrade-effect difference times actual base monument count times the type contribution. Zero base monument count therefore yields no gain in this selected formula.
The inspected physical upgrade getter returns one at upgrade count zero; otherwise it returns 5 times count squared plus 10 times count. It modifies the existing monument effect.
Physical output consumes the updated monument multiplier; derived health and attack consume physical output. Nested common multiplier internals were not all expanded.

findings.failure: Insufficient creation/upgrade stock prevents the ordinary payment/output path. No assigned clones supplies no upgrade work. Missing access hides/unqualifies original allocation controls. Optional paid divinity fallback has its own observed eligibility/price; no free conversion is inferred.
findings.original_transfer: A costly workshop fixture should open a concrete production alternative over real materials and shared paid jobs, rather than another passive numeric monument ladder.
findings.inference: Material production, infrastructure and combat can share real inputs and tradeoffs. ITRTG scale or balance is not a YAIR prescription.
findings.reader_notes: CREATION_FINDINGS.json extracted connected production/upgrade rules. Root correction distinguishes base2000Stone construction from first10Mountain upgrade and replaces duplicate initializer evidence.
limits: All late creations, upgrade families, bulk equations and conversion dependency internals are outside selected review.
No fresh-account play, UI runtime or persistence behavior verified.

findings.path: Available pets -> bounded Growth campaign -> elapsed progress -> actual result claim -> retained pet growth and released assignment

source_observed.observed_rule: The actual pet/campaign page route reaches OHKFICBLBFN; the distinct dungeon route is not campaign evidence.

Campaign commitment stores selected pet IDs and a length from one to twenty-four hours times a base hour reduced by the inspected challenge counter. Growth selection is sorted by current growth. Starting releases those pets' old clone allocations. Tick progression advances elapsed time while duration is positive and awards no growth by itself.
The real half-second callback iterates the saved campaign records and supplies elapsed time.

Unqualified early finish, or a qualified duration below one quarter hour, clears the record and awards nothing. The selected contribution formula caps duration at twenty-four hours and uses current growth, campaign bonuses and duration. Settlement calls this method and sums its returned contributions. Equipment/family modifier internals remain bounded limits.

findings.path: Clock/elapsed eligibility -> offline batch progress -> capped targets/summary -> platform milestone

More than1800seconds in a timed challenge offers accept/skip; accepted positive elapsed sets calculating flag, clears supplied elapsed and snapshots timestamps before coroutine. Nonpositive elapsed marks processed without progression.

No universal72h Steam offline cap is established by this method; no usable timestamp returnszero.

Positive elapsed converts seconds to milliseconds and advances inspected counters. One selected challenge counter is independently clamped43200000ms, not all gameplay. Rested creating boost increases by elapsed/6 up to10800000ms. Delegates physical and skill progress to DHMAIHJDJBF and separate combat/creation functions. Middle pet/equipment/village systems not comprehensively read.

NTC suppresses physical/skill offline progress. Existing assigned workers and actual unlock eligibility determine progression. Per-level interval is at least30ms; skill use decrement is bounded with10000uses times3. Configured target moves workers and remaining time to next eligible work. Gain updates real level, corresponding stat and lifetime counters; summary reports actual range gained.

Aggregates inspected gains, advances active challenge elapsed, refreshes timestamps/state, clears calculating and marks processed, and clears calculation state. Detailed summary is displayed above300seconds. This is in-memory publication, not audited durable-save failure atomicity.

Scheduled allocator counts enabled categories and divides currently allocatable clones by category count. Each category rechecks relevant unlocked system and invokes its real assigner. Disabled or unavailable systems receive no category allocation; ordering can matter. This is bounded sharing, not a general optimal scheduler.

Null/quitting/uninitialized Steam guards return. Already-marked achievement skips. Light/universe/first-monument/monster achievements inspect actual counters or owned creation state before completion helper. Full achievement catalogue not semantically reviewed.

If initialized, sets local completion boolean then requests Steam SetAchievement and StoreStats. Return success/error is not audited here, so cannot claim reliable server completion or transactional award.

findings.failure: Offline disabled, pending calculation or missing/nonpositive timestamp yields no catch-up; timed-challenge skip records no inferred progress.
findings.inference: Time admission, result aggregation and resource stopping should be explicit; online and offline are separate implementations, not assumed equivalent.
findings.original_transfer: Use committed itinerary/job receipts to show elapsed work, actual gains and blocked reason; retain current freeze policy. Any offline catch-up remains a separate future decision.
limits: No whole-game offline equivalence, performance, exploit or save-failure proof.
